prior_clues.verification: Document search only; prior checkers not rerun
prior_clues.fixed_active_split: Complexification and continuous angles retain the same fixed pulse-direction space; they do not evade the scoped rank obstruction.
prior_clues.coordinate_changes: Faithful reparametrization does not add unavailable actions. Nonlinear or multiparticle encodings require a separately specified operation-preserving representation.
prior_clues.possible_new_model: The existing 137-comparison phase-backreaction model changes interaction directions dynamically, but uses a different carrier, action and supplied coefficients.
prior_clues.new_model_gate: Only consider a separately versioned audit after realization equivalence and behavioural minimality are specified; no controls are imported into the frozen six-pulse candidate.
prior_clues.fock_boundary: A larger Fock carrier is not an encoding or compiler; specify code, preparation, all generator actions, reader and auxiliary return.
prior_clues.dimension_boundary: Behaviourally distinct classical states, amplitude dimension and physical representation dimension are different quantities.

candidate_audit.chosen_for: Existing explicit preparation/coupling/readout model; compatibility is to be tested, not assumed
candidate_audit.candidate: The documented directed-transition-probe 24-carrier/6-record oscillator specialization, using only its explicitly supplied controls
required_audit_fields: existing primitive Hamiltonians and allowed controls
candidate_audit.acceptance: Every checklist field is sourced or explicitly marked missing; new operations cannot be inferred from algebraic span or abstract controllability
possible_outcomes: partial contract with explicit missing interfaces

A.claim: For each fixed eta, invariant carrier pairings are H=cI, c>0; unit feature normalization fixes c=1/3

B.quantifier: For the single declared M, there exists a compositional compiler for every finite word in the frozen generator fragment

vertices.S: Frozen finite source-process fragment on A4 x Bool

tetrahedron.coherence: (c whisker alpha);delta = (gamma whisker a);beta, from c b a to f
tetrahedron.comparison_contract: Retain preparation, named pointer readings, carrier successors, auxiliary return and all authorized continuations. Specify the actual 2-cell and 3-cell types; scalar agreement is insufficient.

representation-priors.scope: Prior documents inspected for methods and boundaries; no fresh verification or operation-preserving identification with this target.

candidate-apparatus.scope: Named candidate for a bounded provenance/interface audit; not a newly admitted physical model or freshly verified implementation.

prior-controls.scope: Prior documents inspected, not freshly verified or identified with the seed recorder.

nodes.statement: Candidate: an independently declared reversible writable memory task necessarily selects one contextual response class.
nodes.scope: One-bit native-bound counterexample and separate finite four-state frame-invariant countermodel; not rejection of classification or all more specific tasks.
nodes.falsifier: Multiple admitted implementations give different readings under the same authorized continuation.

nodes.statement: Candidate: fixing the native transition query and conjugation covariance selects its positive pairing and exchange response.
nodes.scope: Positive invariant weights on the same A4 query table give AB;BA responses 1/3 and 1/2; native query composition does not imply pairing isometry.
nodes.falsifier: Same query, preparation, exchange formula and reader admit different normalized overlaps.

nodes.statement: Candidate: native triangle left-action isometries alone select every positive carrier inner product.
nodes.scope: H=(I+lambda J)/(3+9lambda) at lambda=0 and 1/9 is positive and transport invariant but gives different responses. The diagonal-measure theorem remains valid.
nodes.falsifier: Two positive invariant inner products yield 1/3 and 1/2 on the same continuation.

nodes.statement: On the declared real A4 amplitude carrier, triangle left-action isometries and self-adjoint native query multiplication force H=cI.
nodes.scope: Conditional written classification with exact 132-pair translated-query checks; not a new Agda theorem or derivation of its physical premises.
nodes.falsifier: A nonscalar positive H satisfies all stated joint conditions.

nodes.statement: Candidate: reversible input-retaining Boolean recording automatically preserves the attached joint norm.
nodes.scope: The controlled-xor recorder changes squared norm 11/18 to 7/12 under a positive product pairing with pointer overlap 1/2.
nodes.falsifier: Exact inverse recovery and correct query recording coexist with a nonzero norm defect.

nodes.statement: Isometric nondemolition recording into unit pointer states with overlap not equal to one forces opposite query sectors to be orthogonal.
nodes.scope: Written inner-product theorem and exact finite Gram-defect checks. Pointer orthogonality is not assumed; product pairing and isometry are. No arbitrary mixed-instrument classification.
premises: carrier unchanged within each query sector
unit pointer overlap different from one
nodes.falsifier: A nonzero cross-sector overlap satisfies the stated isometric nondemolition equations.

nodes.statement: Construct the controlled Boolean recorder as an actual native-admitted equivalence with blank correctness, unchanged source transport, exact undo, native-table agreement and retained witness recovery.
nodes.scope: Fresh safe Cubical proof for supplied Vertex equivalences and query endpoints; not a microscopic pulse compiler, autonomous preparation, pairing theorem or unique source-selected task.
nodes.falsifier: Native execution disagrees with controlled recording, recovery fails, or the claimed false blank survives the ABC/AB negative control.

nodes.statement: Specify the exact finite-word language interpreted on A4 x Bool and its native interpretation.
nodes.scope: Declared free monoid of eight generators on A4 x Bool, chronological evaluation, supplied blank and retained literal history. Exact 24-state/585-short-word regressions pass. The native embedding and full L_h/all-word comparison remain proof obligations. This is not endpoint-typed seed-walk syntax or physical authorization.
nodes.next_action: Declare objects, generators, domains, empty words, composition, allowed relations, record initialization, queries and readings; give the native map for each generator and word constructor.
nodes.deliverable: A frozen syntax and interpretation contract with examples and rejection cases; decide whether primitive words or a quotient are used before proving descent.
nodes.falsifier: Two incompatible languages fit the contract, a generator lacks a native interpretation, or a relation erases an authorized continuation distinction.

nodes.statement: Specify exactly which coordinate changes count as equivalent mathematical realizations.
nodes.scope: Specification gate; no undefined 'up to equivalence' remains in Output A.
nodes.next_action: State the types and equations for preserving generator labels, initialization, query readings, product decomposition, pointer eta and positive pairing; specify scale normalization and whether source relabellings are allowed.
nodes.deliverable: An explicit equivalence relation or groupoid, with a permitted coordinate-change example and a rejected readout-changing example.
nodes.falsifier: The quotient identifies different authorized continuation readings or silently changes eta, preparation, source labels or normalization.

nodes.statement: Audit the named existing directed-transition oscillator candidate against the frozen checklist without adding primitives.
nodes.scope: All eight checklist fields disposed of in the declared audit. Unknown code/pointer, return and accuracy interfaces remain; no primitives added and no physical model accepted. Audit completion is not implementation existence.
nodes.next_action: Read the named packet and its implementation; inventory exactly the supplied controls, preparations, readout and resource conditions, and mark all missing A4 x Bool/pointer interfaces.
nodes.deliverable: A source-linked complete candidate contract, a partial contract with missing interfaces, or a scoped incompatibility. Each checklist field must have a disposition.
nodes.falsifier: The audit invents a controlled coupling, silently promotes an arbitrary unitary to an allowed primitive, or substitutes the A4 carrier for the documented oscillator carrier without an adapter.

nodes.statement: Candidate: an injective linear encoding of the target 24-state amplitude representation into the 30-mode six-pulse oscillator representation intertwines every target generator.
nodes.scope: Rejected for arbitrary finite words in the six fixed passive pulses: rank(U-I)<=6 while the required triangle has rank(L-I)=16. Common global phase does not help. This is not a no-go for all Fock, nonlinear, measurement-assisted or enlarged-interaction realizations.
nodes.falsifier: The shared fixed-subspace invariant excludes an injective intertwiner already for L_ABC; a purported repair changes the representation or allowed dynamics and needs a new contract.

nodes.statement: Classify future-observation equivalence of the frozen 24 classical states under all allowed query/translation words and Boolean boundary readings.
nodes.scope: Finite predictive-state classification, not a lower bound on Hilbert dimension or proof of physical source identifiability. Retained history provenance is not itself an added observable.
nodes.next_action: Compute the greatest observation-preserving transition congruence and supply separating continuation witnesses for inequivalent states; prove that refinement has stabilized.
nodes.deliverable: An exact minimal predictive-state quotient with a complete finite certificate and explicit separation from amplitude/physical dimension claims.
nodes.falsifier: A proposed merge has a distinguishing continuation, the quotient fails transition closure, or classical state count is treated as forced amplitude dimension.

nodes.statement: Specify actual 2-cell and 3-cell types for the four faces and their tetrahedral comparison.
nodes.scope: Specification gate; diagram boundaries alone are not complete witness types and no higher theorem is claimed.
nodes.next_action: Define protocol equivalence, exact versus approximate comparison, composition/whiskering, continuation and auxiliary-return obligations, and the equality type between complete face pastings.
nodes.deliverable: Typed definitions for alpha, beta, gamma, delta and their two pastings, including whether any witness types are propositions and why.
nodes.falsifier: Whiskering is ill typed, the two pastings have different boundaries, or equality is asserted only after discarding retained resource/continuation data.

nodes.statement: Package Output A as the exact invariant-pairing classification for the frozen generator fragment and each supplied eta.
nodes.scope: The conditional component arguments exist; the assembled moduli interface and its exact native-fragment comparison have not been checked. Pointer overlap and physical units are not selected.
nodes.next_action: After the syntax and equivalence gates close, prove necessity H=cI and sufficiency for the frozen generators and all finite words, retaining eta as a parameter.
nodes.deliverable: A named Output-A classification with explicit existence, uniqueness scope and native semantic binding.
nodes.falsifier: A nonscalar H satisfies all generator isometries, or the chosen quotient erases a named operation or reading.

nodes.statement: Declare one physical model M and allowed operation/resource grammar before testing implementation existence.
nodes.scope: This is a specification gate, not an assertion that a suitable M already exists. No post-failure enlargement of M is allowed within the same conjecture.
nodes.next_action: Record the rejected direct linear implementation class, resolve or explicitly delimit the remaining candidate contract unknowns, and decide whether to retain a fully specified M with that no-go or propose a separately reviewed model. Do not import phase-backreaction or Fock controls into this candidate. A different model needs a new version.
nodes.deliverable: An immutable model contract with exact or explicitly bounded approximate correctness and no hidden source-pointer coupling.
nodes.falsifier: A required primitive, pairing or resource is added after failure without declaring a new model/version.

nodes.statement: For the single frozen M, construct a compositional finite-protocol compiler whose semantics realizes a member of Output A.
nodes.scope: Output B; existential for that M, not for some unspecified apparatus. A failed search is not an impossibility proof.
nodes.next_action: Compile each generator and prove composition with explicit resource accounting, or derive an invariant excluding a required generator.
nodes.deliverable: A compiler with preparation, successor, pointer and auxiliary-return certificates, or a scoped no-go theorem.
nodes.falsifier: An invariant of the allowed primitives excludes recording or its required clean return, or compiled composition violates the declared error/resource contract.

nodes.statement: Construct beta: e a => f on the frozen fragment.
nodes.scope: S-N-R face; the native recorder theorem alone is not a full amplitude-semantic comparison for every word.
nodes.next_action: Define a,e,f and compare direct source interpretation with native-mediated interpretation.
nodes.deliverable: A compositional comparison retaining named operations and readings.
nodes.falsifier: An authorized word has different direct and native-mediated semantics.

nodes.statement: Construct gamma: c b => e for native compiled operations.
nodes.scope: N-P-R face; include joint state, preparation, pointer and auxiliary return, not just probabilities.
nodes.next_action: Compare physical execution semantics with native interpretation on the whole admitted input domain.
nodes.falsifier: Correct pointer labels coexist with wrong successor state, residual auxiliary correlation or failed continuation.

nodes.statement: Construct delta: c d => f for the source-level protocol route.
nodes.scope: S-P-R face; direct compilation must be explicitly defined and its provenance retained.
nodes.next_action: Specify d and compare its execution against the source interpretation, including resource conditions.
nodes.falsifier: Direct protocol semantics disagrees with the declared source operation or silently substitutes another task.

nodes.statement: Construct alpha: b a => d between direct and native-mediated compilation.
nodes.scope: S-N-P face; compare in the declared protocol equivalence, not by matching final scalar records.
nodes.next_action: Define the protocol comparison relation and supply a comparison compatible with composition and resource return.
nodes.deliverable: A compiler-route coherence cell with retained provenance.
nodes.falsifier: The routes differ under an authorized continuation or require incompatible apparatus resources.

nodes.statement: Construct a 3-cell equating (c whisker alpha);delta with (gamma whisker a);beta.
nodes.scope: A typed higher comparison of complete face witnesses; four separately valid faces do not automatically establish it.
nodes.next_action: Freeze the comparison 2/3-cell types and prove equality of the two pastings from c b a to f.
nodes.deliverable: A tetrahedral coherence witness compatible with the frozen continuation and resource semantics.
nodes.falsifier: Face witnesses yield inequivalent pastings or their claimed equality forgets apparatus/continuation data.

nodes.statement: Assemble Output A and Output B with all four faces and their tetrahedral coherence for one frozen physical model.
nodes.scope: An implementation and compatibility objective, not an unconditional derivation of physical kinematics or empirical validation. Pairing selection and protocol existence remain different claims.
nodes.next_action: Define realization equivalence, classify behavioural minimality, and disposition the audited candidate with its scoped rejection. Keep all physical compiler and tetrahedral claims blocked until their contracts and witnesses exist.
nodes.deliverable: A single same-source realization diagram and common witness, or a specifically located obstruction.
nodes.falsifier: The assembly changes M, assumes an undisclosed pairing law, imports unrelated source realizations or lacks a required coherence/resource witness.

frontier_semantics: Actionable open nodes whose research prerequisites are resolved; blocked open nodes remain explicit.
